summary: Frontend-only test of theme-aware chatbot name, footer tagline, app version, domestic FPID/TRN, and international transfer freeze-fix. 4/5 features working. CRITICAL BUG: International transfer still crashes (not a freeze this time — a runtime TypeError in the inline receipt render). Root cause is a data-shape mismatch between offline-adapter.ts response and the screen's expected shape.

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime TypeError: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading toFixed)' at international-transfer.tsx:150. `receipt.amountReceived` (populated from `res.data.amount_received`) is undefined because offline-adapter.ts returns the field as `converted_amount`, not `amount_received`. Additionally `res.data.estimated_arrival` is missing from the adapter response and `res.data.fpid` from the adapter is `SWIFT##########` (does NOT match the required /FP\w{14}/ pattern). The inline-receipt card `[data-testid=intl-receipt]` never rendered because the render threw before reaching the TRN/FPID rows.

integration_issues.flow: International transfer → offline adapter response contract
integration_issues.issue: Adapter (/api/transfers/international POST) returns { ...txn, converted_amount, rate } but screen reads amount_received, estimated_arrival, and expects fpid to start with 'FP'. Fix adapter response: return amount_received (=converted), estimated_arrival (e.g. '2-3 business days for SWIFT'), and change fpid generation to `FP` + 14 alphanum uppercase chars. See offline-adapter.ts lines 393-433.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' React Native Web 0.19+ prefers boxShadow. Non-blocking but should be migrated across StyleSheet.create blocks (multiple files, e.g. chat.tsx, transfers.tsx).
Console warns: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — coming from an RN component (likely a Modal or overlay). Move pointerEvents into style prop.

action_items: URGENT FIX in /app/frontend/src/services/offline-adapter.ts /transfers/international handler (~line 433): change the return payload to include `amount_received: converted`, `estimated_arrival: '2-3 business days'` (or similar), and change `fpid` to `FP` + 14 uppercase alphanum chars (drop the 'SWIFT' prefix) so it matches the /FP\w{14}/ regex the receipt uses.

Alternatively (cheaper fix) update /app/frontend/app/international-transfer.tsx lines 117-126 to read `res.data.converted_amount` and provide a fallback ETA string when undefined — but the FPID prefix mismatch still needs fixing in the adapter to satisfy the /FP\w{14}/ regex.
Address the shadow* → boxShadow and pointerEvents deprecations across shared components once functional bugs are resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: Data-contract mismatch between offline-adapter.ts and international-transfer.tsx caused the crash — a shared TypeScript type for the international-transfer response (used by both adapter and screen) would have prevented this.

The international-transfer.tsx submit handler does NOT reset `isSubmitting` on the render-throw path; if the crash didn't take down the whole screen, the submit button would stay disabled. Consider wrapping the setReceipt call in try/catch.
seed_data_creation: Seeded localStorage key 'hsbc_customization' with the Santander theme to validate theme swap; reset back to HSBC before running domestic + international tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login screen auto-selects user Oliver; entering any 4 digits bypasses. Chat + Profile theme reactivity verified with Santander seed. Domestic transfer receipt WORKS end-to-end and shows Reference=Lunch, FPID=FP<14>, TRN=TRN<12>, Status=Completed, Footer='HSBC UK | Secure Banking'. International transfer FAILS after passcode entry due to adapter/screen contract mismatch — reproduce by /international-transfer, fill Alice Johnson / DE89370400440532013000 / COBADEFFXXX / DE / 100 / 'Family support', tap Send Transfer, enter passcode 1234 → RED SCREEN 'TypeError toFixed'. Verify fix by watching for [data-testid=intl-receipt] and rcpt-trn matching /TRN\w{12}/ and rcpt-fpid matching /FP\w{14}/.
rca_of_issue: SYMPTOM: International transfer screen throws a runtime TypeError after passcode entry, preventing the inline receipt card (intl-receipt) from rendering. ROOT CAUSE: /app/frontend/src/services/offline-adapter.ts (line ~433) returns `{ ...txn, converted_amount, rate }` for POST /transfers/international, but /app/frontend/app/international-transfer.tsx (lines 117-126) accesses `res.data.amount_received`, `res.data.estimated_arrival`, and `res.data.fpid`. `amount_received` and `estimated_arrival` are undefined; calling `.toFixed(2)` on undefined at line 150 crashes the render. ADDITIONALLY the adapter's fpid string is `SWIFT##########` which will not match the required `/FP\w{14}/` regex even after the crash is fixed. MITIGATION (adapter side): change return to `ok({ ...txn, amount_received: converted, converted_amount: converted, rate, estimated_arrival: '2-3 business days', fpid: 'FP' + randAlphaNum(14) }, config);`.
